patthana14.17:1.1: āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na āsavavippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.17:2.1: āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto ceva na no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.17:3.1: āsavañceva āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo ceva na āsavavippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana14.17:4.1: hetuyā nava, sabbattha nava āsava vippayuttaṃ
